full_judgment: 3. Defendant Nos. 2 and 3, upon denial of the averments made by the plaintiffs, assert that the lands of suit khatian together with other lands were put to auction for arrear of rents in certificate proceeding No. 408/49-50 and purchased by defendant No. 1 on 24 May 1954 and that defendant No. 1 subsequently transferred the suit land to defendant Nos. 2 and 3 who have since been in possession thereof.
